author: Amr
subject: feat(quest): implement Quest Solutions Framework
body:
Implements the 10-step plan for centralized quest solution validation, answer keys, and reference materials.

Framework: shared validation toolkit (common.sh, scoring.sh), CLI validator with --all/--level/--json modes, point-based scoring engine with rank thresholds, templates for README, answer-key, and validation scripts.

Structure: centralized at test/quest-solutions/ (levels 0000-0101), migrated Oh-My-Zsh solution from pages/_quests/0010/solutions/, per-level READMEs.

CI/CD: GitHub Actions workflow validates required files, shebangs, reports, and internal links on push/PR.

Integration: updated test/README.md, quest template, Level 0010 README, cleaned _config.yml.

author: Amr
subject: feat(quests): enhance quest frontmatter and validator v2.0.0
body:
Comprehensive quest system improvements across 93 quest files and tooling:

Quest Frontmatter Enhancements:
- Level 0000: Added quest_line, quest_arc, quest_dependencies,

Quest Validator v2.0.0:
- Added placeholder content detection (brackets, TODO, lorem ipsum)

Tooling:

- Improved remove-placeholder-deps.py with dynamic regex patterns
- Full audit report: 136 quests, 0 errors, 93.9% avg score

author: Amr
subject: fix(ci): resolve workflow failures across 7 workflows
body:
Fixes:
- frontmatter-validation, dependency-checker, update-settings: PAT_TOKEN
  auth fallback to GITHUB_TOKEN when PAT_TOKEN is unavailable
- quest-validation: JS syntax error from backticks in template literals;
  switched to process.env variables
- build-validation: added shell: bash and robust error handling for
  jekyll doctor on Windows runners
- prd-sync: YAML indentation error in multiline COMMIT_MSG string
- link-checker: bash floating-point arithmetic error in success_rate
  comparison; truncate to integer before arithmetic

Also removes 12 duplicate blog posts that existed both in root _posts/
and in category subdirectories, causing Jekyll URL conflicts and build
warnings.

author: Amr
subject: fix(ci): replace expired PAT_TOKEN with GITHUB_TOKEN in workflows
body:
- dependency-checker: use GITHUB_TOKEN for both checkout steps
- frontmatter-validation: use GITHUB_TOKEN for checkout and PR comments
- update-settings: use GITHUB_TOKEN for checkout
- prd-sync: add issues:write permission for issue creation

Root cause: PAT_TOKEN secret is expired but non-empty, so the
${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} fallback never
triggers (|| only activates on falsy/empty values).

Fix: Use GITHUB_TOKEN directly since it has sufficient permissions
with the workflow-level contents:write and pull-requests:write grants.

author: Amr
subject: fix(ci): handle datetime serialization in frontmatter validator
body:
YAML safe_load parses date fields (lastmod, date) as datetime objects.
json.dump() cannot serialize these natively. Added DateTimeEncoder
class that converts datetime/date objects to ISO 8601 strings.

subject: fix(ci): fix bash backtick interpretation and missing labels in dependency checker

  security, automated)
- Added file existence check for summary.md before cat
- Added continue-on-error: true since issue creation is non-critical
- Changed heredoc delimiter from EOF to ISSUE_EOF to avoid conflicts

author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
subject: fix: prevent PRD Machine recursive commit loop
body:
Three fixes to stop auto-sync commits from being created every 6 hours
when no meaningful content has changed:

1. Filter out auto-sync commits from signal ingestion to prevent
   self-referential counting (prd-machine.py)
2. Add content-diff check that strips volatile metadata (timestamps)
   and only writes PRD.md when meaningful changes exist (prd-machine.py)
3. Add [skip ci] to commit message to prevent push-triggered re-runs
   (prd-sync.yml)
